answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in walnut, expire in ocean, and signal lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 151 aliases therefore needs 99 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2531 identities would post 3412 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
